values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Pipeline and Gas Journal article from April 2020 calls Phase 2 of the Gulf Coast Southbound project one of several projects to boost gas deliveries to LNG export facilities on the Gulf Coast. The Energy Information Administration project list says the phase carries gas to Corpus Christi LNG in Texas.

verifications.note: Names Phase 2 of Gulf Coast Southbound and ties it to LNG liquefaction and export facilities.
Project list entry for Phase II says it adds capacity from Illinois to Corpus Christi LNG in Texas, demand served LNG.

records.researcher_notes: The article ties the project to LNG exports in general. The Corpus Christi name comes from the Energy Information Administration project list.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Kinder Morgan open season notice from April 2018 for Phase 3 lists the Sabine Pass Liquefaction Plant among its delivery markets. The Energy Information Administration project list also gives LNG as the demand served.

verifications.note: Names Phase 3 of the Gulf Coast Expansion Project and lists the Sabine Pass Liquefaction Plant as a delivery market, with secondary access to Freeport LNG and Corpus Christi.
Project list entry for Phase III gives demand served as LNG.

records.researcher_notes: LNG is one of several delivery markets in the notice. Sabine Pass is the only terminal listed as a primary delivery point. The sheet status is shelved.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: An RBN Energy post from January 2023 says the Gulf Run pipeline carries Haynesville gas to Louisiana LNG export projects and that Golden Pass LNG is its anchor shipper. The Energy Information Administration project list says it connects the Carthage and Perryville hubs to LNG facilities on the Gulf Coast.

verifications.note: Names Gulf Run and says Golden Pass LNG is the anchor shipper on the pipeline.
Project list entry says Gulf Run connects the Carthage and Perryville hubs to LNG facilities along the Gulf Coast, demand served LNG.

records.researcher_notes: Golden Pass is the named anchor shipper. Other LNG terminals may use it but no source names them.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Natural Gas Intelligence article says the Coastal Bend Header project would serve Freeport LNG. The Energy Information Administration project list calls the header a Freeport LNG supply line.

verifications.note: Names the Coastal Bend Header and says it serves the Freeport LNG terminal.
Project list entry for Coastal Bend Header says Freeport LNG supply.

records.researcher_notes: Two sources agree, but the Energy Information Administration list is a compiled data source, so the sources are not counted as independent.

records.segment_name: Eunice Reliability and Lake Charles Supply Project

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Energy Information Administration project list gives the demand served for this project as industrial and LNG. No terminal is named. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission notice names an electric utility and gas marketers in the Lake Charles area.

verifications.note: Project list entry for the Eunice Reliability and Lake Charles Supply Project gives demand served as Industrial/LNG.

records.researcher_notes: Only the Energy Information Administration entry mentions LNG, and it names no terminal. No company or filing source found that ties the project to a specific terminal. Please look at this one.
